text: Could a vastly larger survey rescue the test? To reach 3 standard deviations at the generous signal size would require about 36 trillion galaxies. Published estimates put about 2 trillion galaxies in the observable universe. The test therefore needs 18 observable universes of galaxies. Even perfectly classifying every galaxy that exists would reach only 0.74 standard deviations. There is no larger catalogue waiting beyond all the galaxies we can observe.
